context: November 25 gapped up and rallied, but the selling came back as fast. The rejection has already pushed out the buyers who came in, so no buyer stops are left to hunt. Sensex expires tomorrow.
plan: ANY OPEN -> BUY: the buyers were already pushed out, so the plan is the same on a gap down, a flat open or a gap up; identify buying-side setups.
FLAT OPEN IS THE RISK: IH warns a flat open may build a small sideways range with no momentum; same plan, less conviction.
